title: School Deployment, Security, Privacy & ST4S Readiness

governingSource.notes: Guide pp.10–11 readiness list uses parent C/P references, duplicates AI_PR3 and prints AI_5; use detailed AI_T5 and include AI_PR2/AI_SF6A from detailed criteria. No silent omitted control. Question excerpts are locators; full source tier/response columns govern.

statusDefinitions.PASS—VERIFIED: Applicable requirement satisfied for exact scope by current validated evidence; never inferred from provider marketing.
statusDefinitions.LIKELY PASS: Plausible but incomplete proof. Blocks readiness.
statusDefinitions.GAP: Observed missing/unsafe control; source gap may be established while deployed state remains unknown. Blocks readiness.
statusDefinitions.N-A: Documented source-specific non-applicability approved with evidence/date/reviewer. Not a PASS.
statusDefinitions.UNVERIFIED: Unknown configuration, applicability or evidence. Blocks readiness.

tier.candidate: Tier 2 educational game/career guidance only; not a confirmed classification
tier.rationale: P9 data and P10 functionality determine tier. LMS/analytics/two-way communication/payment/file-hosting features may change scope; review full product, not only 3D route.

questions.data: What data is collected or processed, for what purpose, and which fields are personal, sensitive, inferred or optional?
questions.locations: Where are live data, backups, logs, metadata, disaster recovery, test and development data stored AND processed?
questions.accessCountries: Who can access the data, including support, administrators and contractors, and from which countries?
questions.providers: Which third parties/subprocessors receive which data and under which contracts and change-notice terms?
questions.lifecycle: What are retention periods, deletion propagation (including backups), export and termination procedures?
questions.encryption: What encryption and key-management settings protect each transport hop and stored copy?
questions.logging: What is logged, redacted, retained and auditable; who can read/export logs and respond to alerts?
questions.identity: What authentication, MFA, RBAC, session/revocation, password and recovery controls are enforced server-side?
questions.isolation: How is school/class/student isolation enforced and negatively tested against identifier/role tampering?
questions.privacySafety: What privacy, consent, accessibility and student-safety implications, threats and mitigations change?
questions.applicability: Does the ST4S tier, control set, AI module, jurisdiction or conditional evidence applicability change?
questions.verification: Which implementation checks, tests, evidence, policies, diagrams and documentation must be updated?

guardrails: Minimise personal and sensitive data; use synthetic records in development and test. Pseudonyms remain personal when linkable.
Enforce hard school/tenant isolation on the server, database, storage, functions, caches, exports and logs.
Default deny, least privilege and trusted immutable membership; never trust client role, school or student identifiers.
No cross-school discovery by default. Any aggregate comparison needs documented purpose, small-cell protection and security/privacy approval.
Avoid unnecessary student communication/social features; teacher moderation does not replace access control or safety incident handling.
Student-facing AI requires explicit recorded architecture and security approval, privacy/safety assessment, model/provider evidence and AI control applicability review before enablement.
Verify Australian storage AND processing across every component and access country; a database region alone is insufficient.
Never infer compliance from a vendor/product name. Verify deployed configuration, data flows, contracts/subprocessors, operational processes and evidence.

backlog.title: Replace browser-side student authentication and weak password handling
backlog.remediation: Replace client SHA-256 comparison/readable password_hash with server-side managed authentication or a narrowly scoped authenticated session broker. Use a slow salted password KDF if custom auth remains, CSPRNG credentials, rate limits and uniform login errors; revoke direct anonymous credential access. Revoke sessions on reset/deactivation.
backlog.validation: Synthetic student A cannot read any credential hash or impersonate B by altering storage/IDs; brute-force/reset/revocation tests pass.
backlog.evidenceRequired: Local source available; deployment and authenticated configuration remain unverified.

backlog.title: Make tenant membership trusted and immutable to ordinary users
backlog.remediation: Replace school membership inferred from user-editable teachers.school_id with verified immutable auth-subject membership approved by a school administrator. Lock membership/role columns; enforce tenant-consistent foreign keys and class assignment, and eliminate prototype permissive policies.
backlog.validation: Two synthetic schools; attempted self-reassignment, foreign student/class IDs, revoked staff, RPC and direct REST all denied.
backlog.evidenceRequired: Local source available; deployment and authenticated configuration remain unverified.

backlog.title: Isolate feedback and moderation data
backlog.remediation: Replace feedback school IDs embedded in untrusted message JSON with server-bound non-null tenant columns. Remove null-school visibility to all authenticated teachers; unaffiliated reports go only to restricted triage. Scope reviewer roles and immutable audit logs; limit anonymous submission and sanitise inputs.
backlog.validation: Anonymous submission cannot forge tenant identity; malformed/missing school IDs never broaden read access; raw responses visible only to authorised reviewers.
backlog.evidenceRequired: Local source available; deployment and authenticated configuration remain unverified.

backlog.title: Disable default cross-school discovery and validate aggregation
backlog.remediation: Disable anonymous Global Index school/class summaries by default. Any approved cross-school comparison must remove class codes, enforce participation/role controls and minimum cohort thresholds; assess re-identification.
backlog.validation: Unauthenticated and school-A accounts cannot enumerate school-B class codes, small cohorts or identifiable records.
backlog.evidenceRequired: Local source available; deployment and authenticated configuration remain unverified.

backlog.title: Inventory and verify deployed Supabase configuration
backlog.remediation: Obtain read-only project metadata and catalog export; reconcile to source. Inventory all tables/fields/views/materialized views, auth metadata categories, RLS/grants, extensions, triggers/functions, buckets/policies, Edge Functions, webhooks, scheduled jobs, replicas, log drains and backups.
backlog.validation: Signed deployment/schema comparison and component data-flow inventory; no real record dump required.
backlog.evidenceRequired: Primary project identity and ap-southeast-2 region observed live; deeper dashboard stalled. Authenticated Supabase project metadata/region; read-only database catalogs and settings; bucket/function manifests; redacted logs; project membership and support-access attestations; backup/PITR and restore receipts.

backlog.title: Prove residency, support access and provider assurance
backlog.remediation: Record live, backup, log, metadata, DR/test/dev and Edge execution countries; remote support/admin access countries; full chain of subprocessors and relocation-notice lead times. Collect current in-scope IRAP/SOC2 Type II/ISO27001 proof for every component. Where Australian-only requirements cannot be met, restrict/disable the component or obtain a school-approved compliant deployment plan before migration. A second paused project is visible in the same organisation in ap-northeast-1; establish whether it holds related historical data and any migration/deletion obligations without assuming a connection.
backlog.validation: H1/H2 country matrix, H5 enforceable notification workflow, H6 component coverage and school-specific acceptance signed off.
backlog.evidenceRequired: Primary project identity and ap-southeast-2 region observed live; deeper dashboard stalled. Actual project region/settings; signed current DPA/subprocessor list and support access terms; log/backups/CDN/SMTP contracts; H6 reports; school risk report and hosting conditions.

backlog.title: Review auth configuration, MFA and recovery
backlog.remediation: Verify organisation/admin MFA, invitations, trusted teacher onboarding, RBAC, email verification, password policy, reset-token expiry/single use, redirect allowlist, enumeration/rate limits and session lifetime/invalidation. Enforce server-side rather than UI-only school/email checks.
backlog.validation: Synthetic role/recovery matrix and reviewed redacted settings export.
backlog.evidenceRequired: Local source available; deployment and authenticated configuration remain unverified.

backlog.title: Define retention/deletion/export and test full restoration
backlog.remediation: Replace login deactivation/anonymised login labels as a substitute for full deletion. Define per-category retention and school-record obligations; cover Auth, responses/reviews, storage, logs, local caches, backups and recipients. Implement authorised export/deletion and resurrection controls; test restore including storage objects.
backlog.validation: Isolated synthetic full restore and deletion/export propagation receipts, RPO/RTO and backup-expiry evidence.
backlog.evidenceRequired: Local source available; deployment and authenticated configuration remain unverified.

backlog.title: Minimise free text, progress profiles and browser persistence
backlog.remediation: Classify student/staff identifiers, responses/feedback and inferred profiles. Treat wellbeing/financial values as simulated only after verifying provenance; free text may contain sensitive disclosures. Remove unnecessary identity duplication, bound offline persistence, isolate users and clear shared-device data on logout.
backlog.validation: Field/purpose inventory plus shared-device logout, retention and cross-account browser tests.
backlog.evidenceRequired: Local source available; deployment and authenticated configuration remain unverified.

backlog.title: Inventory integrations, downloads, analytics and supply chain
backlog.remediation: Map Supabase, hosting/CDN, SMTP/SSO, external media/docs, telemetry and any export endpoints. Pin/bundle external JavaScript with integrity review (current Supabase loader uses mutable @2 CDN URL); review browser permissions, file MIME/size/malware checks and log redaction.
backlog.validation: Dependency/endpoint inventory, vulnerability scan, permission and download review, no unapproved student-data egress.
backlog.evidenceRequired: Local source available; deployment and authenticated configuration remain unverified.

backlog.title: Review classroom communication, boards, safety and AI applicability
backlog.remediation: Review student responses, teacher feedback, community votes/boards, leaderboards, reflections and wellbeing-themed mechanics; minimise communication, document moderation/report/escalation and staff-student contact rules. Verify all runtime/backend AI pathways before a reasoned AI N-A; authoring AI and simulated AI-themed gameplay do not alone establish student-facing AI.
backlog.validation: Safety misuse tests, moderation audit trail and signed complete feature/tier/AI applicability review.
backlog.evidenceRequired: Local source available; deployment and authenticated configuration remain unverified.

backlog.title: Confirm payments and app/extension applicability
backlog.remediation: Verify shop uses only simulated currency and no card/payment processor across all services. Verify whether native/mobile/desktop/extension builds exist and requested permissions. Record reasoned N-A only with evidence.
backlog.validation: Reviewed complete product inventory and synthetic transaction/permission inspection.
backlog.evidenceRequired: Local source available; deployment and authenticated configuration remain unverified.

backlog.title: Assign operational owners and prepare final school/privacy documents
backlog.remediation: Nominate qualified security/privacy and safeguarding owners; finalise privacy/collection notices, terms, incident notification, training/offboarding, BCP/DR and shared patching responsibilities. Obtain WA public-school risk assessment/catalogue entry and school approval/consent/treatments; separately establish CEWA/ECC requirements.
backlog.validation: Authorised final documents, tabletop and training/access review, school-specific written approval.
backlog.evidenceRequired: Organisation identity/ABN, owner nominations, policy approvals, staff-only WA catalogue/risk report and school/sector requirements.

backlog.title: Independent pre-submission assurance
backlog.remediation: Commission scoped vulnerability assessment, independent penetration test, independent privacy/document review, evidence audit and mock Readiness Check of exact candidate. Fix and retest findings; preserve reports and assessor independence.
backlog.validation: All applicable controls verified, no open blocking findings, final evidence current and mock Ready; authorised submission receipt afterward.
backlog.evidenceRequired: Authorised test scope/accounts and independent qualified reviewers; vendor/hosting testing permission as needed.
